name: Ajay Sanyal
real_life_parallel: Ajit Doval (IB Director 2004-2005; National Security Advisor 2014-present)

biography.background: Director of Intelligence Bureau (IB), India's domestic intelligence agency. Film 1 set during UPA era (2001-2008) when Doval was IB Director. Represents 'operational action' doctrine vs RAW's 'strategic patience'.
biography.doctrine: Proactive intelligence operations; direct action preference; institutional impatience with bureaucratic delays
biography.film_1_role: Hamza's primary handler; IB-RAW friction with Bhullar
biography.film_2_role: Elevated mandate under 'Naya Bharat'; expanded operational authority; Rizwan Shah's handler

institutional_tension.with_ks_bhullar: IB domestic focus vs RAW external focus; operational action vs strategic patience; jurisdictional overlap on transnational terror
institutional_tension.resolution_film_2: Sanyal's elevation under expanded mandate reduces friction through unified command

ajit_doval.background: Kerala cadre IPS; intelligence operations specialist
ajit_doval.significance: First IB officer to become NSA; bridges institutional divides
